description: This file defines a class 'HistogramBucketAggregator' used for aggregating measurement data in histogram buckets. It manages tags, bounds, and accumulated values, and provides methods to add measurements and collect data as 'Measurement<long>'.

classes.name: HistogramBucketAggregator
classes.description: Internal class used for accumulating and managing histogram bucket data, including tag management, value aggregation, and measurement collection.

methods.name: HistogramBucketAggregator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the aggregator with tags, a measurement bound, and a label.

methods.name: Tags
methods.description: Property that returns the tags associated with this histogram bucket.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property that retrieves the current aggregated value.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Method to atomically add a measurement to the current aggregated value.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Method to collect the current measurement data as a 'Measurement<long>' object.
